title: Improving site performance by shipping more CSS
summary: GitHub's engineering team shares their approach to improving site performance by strategically shipping more CSS, likely through critical CSS inlining or eliminating JavaScript-driven styling calculations that were slower than pure CSS solutions.
problem_solved: Addresses render-blocking JavaScript and inefficient runtime style calculations that were degrading page load performance.
why_valuable: Demonstrates counterintuitive but effective performance optimization by moving expensive JavaScript styling computations to pre-compiled CSS, improving Core Web Vitals and user experience.
